answer: Identities funded from a common source within 50 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the delta graph is rebuilt each epoch, the summit merge is applied at settlement and the knoll audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
